method_notes: Straight line in miles (to 3 d.p.), measured by the council's computerised/GIS system from the child's home address point (NLPG geographic reference point; shared buildings e.g. flats use the building reference point) to the designated main school entrance nominated by the school. Community criteria: EHCP, LAC/PLAC, linked infant school, siblings, exceptional medical, distance; ties by random allocation. Allocation table is titled 'Furthest Straight Line Distance' for all schools, including academies/faith/free schools (measured on the same council system). Sources: Croydon Primary Admissions prospectus 2027-28 pp.24,29 and croydon.gov.uk distance page.

Large distances (e.g. Broadmead 18.189, Harris Kenley 20.066, Ridgeway 15.547, Howard 15.434) likely reflect undersubscription but the table does not mark 'all offered', so recorded as distances. Harris Purley Way 2025 shows 'abroad' (overseas last offer). PANs are the 2026 admission numbers parsed from concatenated text (e.g. '309060120...'); treat as indicative. Allocation-breakdown xlsx (criterion-level detail) could not be read. Junior schools excluded (no reception intake).
